intel.title: Challengers Cup 2 crowns five regional champions
intel.body: OMiT Brooklyn (NA), Project 7 (EU), Mindfreak.Black (AP), Origin (LA) and ZERO (ME) win Cup 2. The top four from each region are now reflected in the Challengers pool.

intel.title: Minor 1 field locked: OrglessWIN, FriesInTheBag, OMiT and Huntsmen
intel.body: The four NA Challengers qualifiers join the 12 CDL teams at the Kickoff Classic / Minor 1. All four were already in the pool and are tagged as Minor 1 qualifiers.

intel.title: Challengers Cup 1 crowns five regional champions
intel.body: OrglessWIN (NA), Project 7 (EU), Mindfreak.Black (AP), Origin (LA) and Riyadh Falcons Academy (ME) take the first Cup of the 2027 season.

intel.title: Toronto KOI win Monster Launch Invitational
intel.body: KOI beat Paris Gentle Mates 4–1 in the $100K CDL season opener. Huntsmen, FC Stallions, OMiT Brooklyn and Telluride Bush represented the Challengers field.

intel.title: Sources: FaZe Vegas closing in on Scrap and HyDra
intel.body: The reigning champs are building around Simp, Scrap and HyDra after landing Alluka.

intel.title: Sources: Cloud9 nearing deal for Insight, eyeing full rebuild
intel.body: Cloud9 NY lands Cammy, Insight, Lurqxx and Pred as it retools after a career-worst season.

intel.title: Sources: LA Thieves target Scrap and HyDra reunion
intel.body: Los Angeles explored a superstar duo before the FaZe move accelerated.

intel.title: Vancouver Surge release entire Black Ops 7 roster
intel.body: Surge rebuild around a new core of Vik, Mamba, Nemensions and Wevy.

intel.title: Sources: Gentle Mates target Simp in blockbuster move
intel.body: Paris made the biggest swing of the offseason before Simp stayed in Vegas.

intel.title: Envoy and Nastie declare free agency; SupeR and RenKoR hit the market
intel.body: A busy day of CDL roster movement reshaped four franchises.
